Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You catch the attacking weapon close to its wielder’s hand and force the point away from your body.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self, before a defense roll against an adjacent creature’s melee weapon attack.
Duration
Instant.
Equipment / acquisition
Requires a melee weapon. Grants one ordinary melee weapon, Bulk 1, if absent.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Defense

Use Brawn instead of the attack’s normal defense attribute for this roll. This adds no Boon and makes no extra roll.
